steps.title: Summary Section Visible

steps.title: Total Standing Stat Visible
steps.description: Total student standing count is rendered from live service data

steps.title: PostgreSQL Lifecycle Status Read-Back
steps.description: Confirm stu.lifecycle_status rows exist for pilot tenant under RLS-forced schema
steps.query: SELECT student_id, status FROM stu.lifecycle_status WHERE tenant_id = 'a0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001' LIMIT 1

steps.title: Schema Ownership / RLS Audit
steps.description: Verify lifecycle tables have RLS enabled and FORCED
steps.query: SELECT c.relname FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname = 'stu' AND c.relkind = 'r' AND c.relname LIKE 'lifecycle%' AND c.relrowsecurity = true AND c.relforcerowsecurity = true

steps.title: Negative RBAC — Unauthenticated Gateway Blocked
steps.description: Unauthenticated GET on lifecycle status contract returns HTTP 401
